en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal issued as easterly winds strengthen
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Thunderstorm Warning at 10:30 pm and issued the Strong Monsoon Signal at 10:10 pm, warning of strong easterly winds and rough seas.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Strong Monsoon Signal at 10:10 p.m. on Tuesday, indicating that strong winds with a mean speed exceeding 40 kilometres per hour are expected from the east, with gusts occasionally reaching gale force.

Earlier in the evening the Observatory had issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 7 p.m., which was later extended and then cancelled at 10:30 p.m. Intense gusts of around 70 km/h were recorded at Waglan Island around 9:40 p.m.

The Observatory advised the public to take precautions against strong gusty winds, secure loose objects, and stay away from the shoreline as sea conditions may be rough, particularly over offshore waters. Small craft owners were urged to ensure the safety of their boats.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號生效 吹偏東強風
zh.dek: 天文台晚上10時10分發出強烈季候風信號，預料吹偏東強風，陣風間中達烈風程度，並於10時30分取消雷暴警告。
body: 香港天文台於星期二晚上10時10分發出強烈季候風信號，表示香港境內任何一處接近海平面的地方，平均風速現已或將會超過每小時40公里，吹偏東風，陣風間中達烈風程度。
天文台較早前於晚上7時發出雷暴警告，其後延長有效時間，並於晚上10時30分取消。橫瀾島在約9時40分錄得每小時約70公里的強陣風。
天文台提醒市民提防強陣風，妥善固定可能被風吹走的物件，並遠離岸邊，因海面可能有大浪，離岸海域風浪尤其大。小艇艇戶應採取措施確保船隻安全。
